idea.title: Bounded defensive short-horizon reversal
idea.hypothesis: Recent relative underperformance combined with a volatility screen may identify a synthetic short-horizon reversal candidate.
idea.rationale: Compare two prespecified long-only reversal variants under the same deterministic synthetic evaluator and pass the reviewed result to a human research queue.

strategy_spec.name: One-month reversal with volatility screen
strategy_spec.universe: point-in-time eligible equities below the median trailing volatility
strategy_spec.exit_rule: exit outside the strongest two reversal-signal quintiles
